UI_PZCloud_Subtitle: PZ Cloud Management. Requires the free Knox Net desktop app, running on this PC and connected to Google Drive.
UI_PZCloud_RestoreHint: Downloading keeps a copy on this PC. To restore it, close Zomboid completely and use the desktop app.
UI_PZCloud_Downloading: Downloading the selected copy. Large worlds can take several minutes...
UI_PZCloud_WriteError: Could not send the request. Check the permissions of your Zomboid folder.
UI_PZCloud_Refreshed: Cloud list updated. Select a copy to download it.
UI_PZCloud_Downloaded: Copy downloaded. Close Zomboid and restore it in the desktop app.
UI_PZCloud_Opened: Desktop window requested. Switch to the Knox Net application.
UI_PZCloud_CompanionError: Could not complete the request. Open the desktop app to check your Google connection.
UI_PZCloud_Offline: No response yet. Check that Knox Net is running and connected, then refresh. A large download may still be running.
UI_PZCloud_Ready: Open the desktop app and sign in with Google, then refresh this list.
UI_PZCloud_EmptyHint: Open the desktop app, connect Google and save a world to the cloud.
UI_PZCloud_BrowserOpened: Download page opened. Extract the app, run it and sign in with Google.
UI_PZCloud_BrowserError: Open github.com/SantiagoPana/PZ-Cloud-Management/releases to download the desktop app.
